charts.effectivenessHeatmapFootnote: Each cell = 1 + (incremental revenue ÷ promo spend). 1.40× means the promo drove 40% more revenue than it cost. Green = above 1.0×; red = below. Hover for spend, baseline value, incremental value, and Impact on IGM.

charts.incrementalUnitsHeatmapFootnote: Each cell = actual units minus baseline (no-promo) units for that SKU-week. Green = the promo sold more than baseline; red = it sold less. Hover a cell for baseline units, actual units, and Impact on IGM (the profit-based view of the same week).
